row.name: broadcasts_slug_key
row.where: status = 'active' and slug is not null

row.name: broadcasts_untold_idx
row.where: status = 'active' and state = 'published' and told_at is null

row.name: broadcast_audiences_target_check
row.value: (scope = 'class') = (class_id is not null) and (scope = 'grade') = (grade_descriptor_id is not null)

row.name: broadcasts_publish_at_check
row.value: (state <> 'published' or publish_at is not null) and (state <> 'draft' or publish_at is null)

row.name: broadcasts_title_check
row.value: char_length(title_en) <= 200 and char_length(title_ar) <= 200 and (title_en <> '' or title_ar <> '')

row.name: broadcasts_translation_review_check
row.value: (translation_reviewed_at is null) = (translation_reviewed_by_user_id is null) and (translation_reviewed_at is null) = (translation_source_digest is null)

row.name: broadcasts_announcement_check
row.value: kind = 'announcement' or (urgency = 'normal' and pinned_until is null and expires_on is null and not requires_ack and update_sent_at is null)

row.name: broadcasts_news_check
row.value: (kind = 'news') = (slug is not null) and (kind = 'news' or (visibility = 'school' and category_id is null and excerpt_en = '' and excerpt_ar = '' and cover_file_id is null and cover_alt_en = '' and cover_alt_ar = '' and not pinned))

row.name: broadcasts_slug_check
row.value: slug is null or (char_length(slug) <= 80 and slug ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')
